subject: Econ scenario framework for feature-level pricing
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@averyhealth.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — inference economics for patient-summaries

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier. A few clarifications/estimates from our side to help you sketch the scenarios: 

- Core feature set: patient-summary generation (primary), follow-up-recommendations (secondary), and a smaller medication-normalization microfeature.
- Expected first-year monthly token profile (aggregate across features): baseline 5M tokens/month, scaling to 12M tokens/month by Q4 depending on adoption.
- Request mix: ~70% short summaries (avg 350 tokens/request), 25% mid-length (avg 1,200 tokens), 5% long (avg 3,800 tokens).
- Target budget for inference: $9k–$15k/month during pilot scaling window. This is flexible but the CFO wants a per-feature target that keeps cost < 30% of gross margin impact.
- Procurement: we can run a pilot under a 3-month PO; procurement needs a simple economics sheet and a one-page SOC 2 note.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with token estimates and a simple ARR assumption sheet. Happy to hop on a follow-up — Tues or Wed next week looks good for us.

Lena
Avery Health — Product

Attachments: avery_token_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@averyhealth.com>
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — inference economics for patient-summaries

Lena — really helpful, thanks for sending the numbers. High-level next steps from our side so we keep momentum: 

1) I'll produce two scenario decks by Monday: "Conservative" (5M tokens/mo) and "Scale" (12M tokens/mo) with per-feature unit cost, margin impact, and recommended quantization/throughput settings.
2) Dev will run a quick microbench on a representative prompt mix to estimate $/1M tokens for the three model variants we discussed; we'll include a low-latency and a cost-optimized path.
3) Marissa will draft a one-pager for procurement (pilot PO template + SOC 2 summary).

Couple of clarifying Qs before I run the numbers: 
- Is the $9k–$15k/month budget a firm cap for pilot (i.e., procurement approval), or is there room for the first month to overshoot for data collection?
- Can you confirm whether the patient-data flows will be routed via your VPC (preferred) or through our hosted API for the initial pilot?

If you confirm those two points I'll push the scenarios and a recommended $/feature benchmark. Middle-of-day Tue works for a short call.

— Grace
Grace O'Connor
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: grace.oconnor@redwood.com <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: dev.patel@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: quick econ sketch (for AH pilot)

Team — flagged summary + quick arithmetic so we can align on what to present Monday. Paste below for the record; I'll include this in the scenario deck.

--- assumptions (from Lena + call) ---
- Pilot token run-rate (start): 5,000,000 tokens/mo
- Upside: 12,000,000 tokens/mo
- Pilot budget: $9,000–$15,000/mo
- Target: keep inference cost contribution per-feature <= 30% of feature-level gross margin impact

--- quick calc outputs (work in progress) ---
- If target cost per feature (patient-summary) becomes $/feature = inference_cost_per_request * requests_per_month. Using Lena's avg 350 tokens/request and 5M tokens/mo => ~14,285 requests/mo for patient-summary.
- Candidate $/1M tokens benchmarks we should model: $400, $900, $1,800 (covering quantized/cost-optimized to low-latency larger model).
- At $900 per 1M tokens, 5M tokens => $4,500/mo total inference cost. If patient-summary is 70% of tokens (~3.5M tokens) => patient-summary cost ≈ $3,150/mo. Divided by 14,285 requests => ~$0.22/request.
- Evaluate CAC payback: assume $12k ARR per net-new customer for this feature set and a 15% feature-driven uplift; LTV assumptions TBD. Quick target: CAC payback <= 9 months.

Notes / asks:
- Dev: please run the bench to confirm the $/1M token numbers for the three model variants (include throughput and 95th latency tail). Add KV-cache savings if repeat prefixes apply.
- Marissa: draft two line items for procurement: (1) pilot retainer (month 1), (2) monthly consumption estimate with overage terms. Provide a sample PO language.

I want the scenario deck to include a simple table: tokens/mo | $/1M token | total cost | $/feature | margin impact | CAC-payback estimate. If we can show 2–3 plausible points where the $/feature hits the customer's stated threshold, that should unblock procurement.

— Grace
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@averyhealth.com>
To: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: revops@averyhealth.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — inference economics for patient-summaries

Grace — this looks great, thanks. A couple quick answers: 
- Budget: procurement will accept up to $15k/month for the pilot but prefer we stay under $12k by month 2; first month can overshoot to gather telemetry if clearly scoped.
- Data routing: we can do VPC for the pilot (security team cleared that path) — please include VPC pricing delta if any.

We'd like the deck Tuesday afternoon; 30-minute sync at 2:00pm PT works for the engineering and revops folks. Confirm and send calendar invite.

Lena
